Test Case Description: Test login with valid username and password.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Enter valid username: "standard_user" 3. Enter valid password: "secret_sauce" 4. Click on the login button.
Expected Result: User should be logged in and redirected to the products page.

Test Case Description: Test login with an incorrect username and correct password.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Enter invalid username: "incorrect_user" 3. Enter valid password: "secret_sauce" 4. Click on the login button.
Expected Result: User should not be logged in; an error message should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Test login with a valid username and incorrect password.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Enter valid username: "standard_user" 3. Enter invalid password: "wrong_password" 4. Click on the login button.
Expected Result: User should not be logged in; an error message should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Test login with an empty username and/or password.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Leave the username field empty. 3. Enter valid password: "secret_sauce" (test with empty username) 4. Click on the login button. 5. Enter valid username: "standard_user" 6. Leave the password field empty (test with empty password) 7. Click on the login button.
Expected Result: User should not be logged in; an error message should be displayed for each scenario.
